name: marketingskills
description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
one_liner: A free library that teaches an AI assistant how to do real marketing work — writing ad copy, auditing SEO, planning A/B tests — the way an experienced marketer would.
buyer: A solo founder or small business owner who can't afford a marketing agency but wants their AI assistant to actually run CRO audits, write cold emails, and plan SEO like a hired marketer would.
business_use_cases: A bootstrapped SaaS founder runs the 'seo-audit' and 'cro' skills against their own landing page to get a prioritized list of fixes instead of paying a consultant $2k for the same audit.
A small e-commerce store uses the 'ad-creative' and 'ab-testing' skills to generate and structure a month of ad variant tests without a media buyer.
An agency owner uses the 'competitors' and 'directory' skills to quickly build competitor research decks for new client pitches.

money_ideas.idea: The repo already monetizes via sponsored 'Verified Partner' tool integrations (e.g. conversion tracking, AI website builders) — a marketing-tool vendor could pay for a listing here to reach technical marketers.
Package a 'CMO-in-a-box' service where you run these skills against a client's business monthly and deliver a report, charging a retainer well below a full agency.

steal_this: Pick one skill (e.g. 'cro') and turn it into a $49 self-serve audit tool: business owner drops in their homepage URL, gets a PDF report generated by running this skill against it.
